claims.statement: For every additive direction eta and every finite adaptive physical restriction tree, E_eta(root)=sum_expanded w_v L_eta(v)+sum_frontier w_u E_eta(u). For constant/literal terminal leaves the frontier term vanishes.
claims.scope: all finite Boolean gates, all interior product biases, all finite adaptive physical restriction trees using genuine branch probabilities

claims.statement: If eta is globally gate-safe, every negative weighted local cocycle in a terminal physical restriction tree can be paid by disjoint positive strict-descendant cocycle mass, with no positive mass reused; residual mass in each subtree is exactly w_v E_eta(G_v).
claims.scope: globally gate-safe additive directions with eta(0)=eta(1)=0; finite physical trees ending in constants/literals

claims.statement: For Gamma=Gamma_b+lambda eta and a terminal physical tree, D_Gamma(root)=lambda E_eta(root)-sum_v w_v R_b(v), where R_b is the exact baseline selector debit. The safe-direction contribution is one root-owned bank and cannot be spent twice across levels.
claims.scope: all finite Boolean gates and finite terminal physical restriction trees for which the source exact coordinate recursion applies

claims.statement: With U_b(v)=h2(d_v)+(2/ln2)min(d_v,1-d_v)-J_{Gamma_b}(v)-d_v Gamma_b(s_v), every terminal physical tree satisfies D_{Gamma_b+lambda eta}(root)>=lambda E_eta(root)-sum_v w_v U_b(v). Hence a policy with expected total U_b no larger than the root bank proves the gate defect nonnegative.
claims.scope: all finite Boolean gates, all finite adaptive physical trees ending in constants/literals

claims.scope: balanced uniform Boolean functions; conditional on constructing the stated policy for every such function
